description: This Java class 'MessageAnnotationsExtractAdapter' implements the 'TextMap' interface to extract properties from AMQP 1.0 message annotations, specifically for use with OpenTracing. It provides methods to iterate over message annotation properties and handles message annotation retrieval and type checking.

classes.name: MessageAnnotationsExtractAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for extracting message annotation properties from an AMQP message for tracing purposes.

methods.name: MessageAnnotationsExtractAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with a message and the name of the message annotation map.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the message annotation properties as key-value string pairs.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Unsupported operation; method to insert properties is not supported.

methods.name: getPropertiesMap
methods.description: Retrieves the properties map from the message annotations based on the specified map name.
